# CVMaster

> CVMaster (also written CV Master) is a free AI CV builder at cvmaster.live. People build a one-page CV in minutes, tailor it to a job offer, check their ATS score and download a clean PDF. Available in English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese and Chinese, on the web and as a phone app.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.cvmaster.live/): what CVMaster does, step by step
- [CV templates](https://www.cvmaster.live/templates): 50 layouts in 12 colours, ATS-friendly and creative
- [Pricing](https://www.cvmaster.live/pricing): free to build; €0.99 per clean PDF, or the Job Hunt Pass (€6.99 a month or €14.99 every 3 months)
- [Blog](https://www.cvmaster.live/blog): CV and job-hunting advice
